intersections.note: June (40 ft, faces y 2208/2462) comes from the right edge; its block lines stop at the C.H.&D. tracks (x about 5785) and it crosses the tracks to Long Av. (water pipe continues to x 5135). Long Av. has only its west (works) side drawn and no width printed; centre taken about 25 ft east of the west line and at the water-pipe line. Uncertain by about +-60 px in x

Bismark (faces y 3603/3893; the south face is the line just inside the heavy panel border) ends at Long Av. beside the railroad; works corner at (4912,3603). Long centre assumed 25 ft east of its west line; uncertain by about +-60 px in x

notes: Sheet has two panels split by a heavy line at y about 3900. UPPER (part upper, y 0-3900): The Emery Candle Co., St. Bernard, north of Ivorydale; north arrow points up-left. Bismark Av. (printed BISMARK AV., 50 ft) along the bottom of the panel from the left edge to Long Av.; Long Av. (printed LONG AV., no width) runs top to bottom on the right between the candle works / dwellings 48-70 (west line x 5031 at the top, about 4912 at Bismark) and the C.H.&D. R.R. (tracks from x 5395); its east side is not drawn and a railroad spur curves across it, so its centreline is approximate. North of y about 730 the R.R. Store Ho. sits on Long's line, so Long may end there (not recorded). June (40 ft) enters from the right edge east of the C.H.&D. tracks. The line at y about 720 across the top is a property line, not a street; the 125 px gap in Bismark's north face at x 860-985 is where the compass needle crosses, not a street. LOWER (part lower, y 3900-7796): south-west of Ivorydale, north arrow points to the upper right (same rotation as 663/664): Spring Grove Av. (100 ft) runs from the panel border at the top centre down-right to the right edge, Ross Run (creek), P&G Co.'s box factory and resin shed, R.R. sidings and the C.C.C.& St.L. R.R. Beech Av. (printed BEECH AV., 50 ft) runs along the right edge with only its west face on the sheet; its junction with Spring Grove is at the right paper edge (west-face corner about (6494,5685)) and its centre is on sheet 663, so it is not picked here. The lower panel has no intersections.
